title: Grants page props, contract version 1
description: The props of the panel's grants page, Access/Grants (PRD 5.10, 13.4): the address the logout posts to; the read of grant.list as the person: its result, the document of grant.list.result.v1.json the query's result codec wrote at the person's classification access, or the rejection, the problem details (problem.v1.json) of a rejected read, one of the two and never both; and the languages the installation's sites publish in, which the form offers as the locales of a grant. The pickers of the form are the optional prop `pickers` beside these, access-grant-pickers.v1.json. The PHP form is Cbox\Cms\Panel\Domain\Dto\AccessGrantsPage, and the generated codec AccessGrantsPageCodecV1 writes its canonical JSON: keys sorted, no whitespace.

locales.description: The language tags the installation's sites publish in (cbox-cms.sites), sorted and each once, which the form offers as the locales a grant holds in; a grant without locales holds in every language.

logout.description: The address the logout posts to.

rejection.description: The problem details of a rejected read, a document of problem.v1.json, or null for an answered read. Validate it with the validator of ProblemV1.

result.description: The result of grant.list, a document of grant.list.result.v1.json as the query's result codec wrote it, or null for a rejected read. Validate it with the validator of GrantListV1.

locale.description: A language tag of a language, an optional script and an optional region, such as da, en-GB or sr-Latn-RS; the kernel writes the language in lowercase, the script in title case and the region in uppercase.
